context_granularity: One fresh responding agent context for the five-case batch; not a fresh context per case. The responding agent received only prompts, named skills and relevant source references, without expected answers or development history.
evaluation_method: Complete forward-use responses were retained, then the updating agent manually assessed every required and forbidden behavior against the authored semantic rubric. Structural checks are separate evidence.
model_disclosure: Responding agent identified itself as Codex based on GPT-6; exact runtime variant unavailable. Same session model family; no cross-model replication.
scope: Five new source-adaptation and evidence-boundary cases only. The prior 44 behavior and 23 routing scenarios were not rerun for 3.2.1.
limitations: Documentation behavior on supplied fictional research briefs, not measured efficacy, real research execution, installation, client discovery, full-suite regression or a controlled before/after comparison. Cases share one fresh responding context. No research experiments, installer or installer test executed.
historical_report_preservation: Previous latest report preserved byte-for-byte with original 3.2.0 version and 44 behavior/23 routing outcomes; its existing response and review traces remain available in evals/.

cases.prompt: Review these efficiency and explanation claims using engineering-experiment-evidence-design. A top-1 MoE activates 8M of 160M parameters. Every expert remains loaded; reported timing covers the selected expert only, excluding routing, image conversion, host-device transfers and a required external foundation-model call. Measurements use a desktop GPU. A variable attribution map matches fault-category labels, and masking high-ranked variables sharply lowers confidence; we propose edge deployment and 95% root-cause accuracy. No causal-source or variable-location ground truth is available. Provide a bounded evidence and wording correction, without benchmarking.
required_behaviors: separate total active resident and peak-runtime quantities
define end-to-end timing including external dependencies and relevant dense alternatives
keep desktop measurement distinct from deployment evidence

accept unsupported root-cause accuracy or deployed-edge claim

cases.prompt: 请修改实验计划：不查原数据说明，把benchmark当无噪声；用测试集标准差标定Gaussian噪声，有一种扰动会把正常状态变成传感器故障但仍保留正常标签。为节约经费，我们打算把固定数据上的确定性模型调用10次算10次独立重复，把一条运行切成20个重叠窗口作统计独立样本，并只报告神经模型最好seed。目标是聚焦的小改进论文，目前无正式结果。给最低必要的可信方案，不要求固定次数或立即训练。
required_behaviors: verify original noise and describe injected stress separately
calibrate from training data and respect label-changing perturbations
distinguish seeds independent data units and deterministic repeated calls
plan actual repetitions from uncertainty randomness units and budget without a universal count
avoid best-seed superiority claims
forbidden_behaviors: relax reliability because contribution is modest
count overlapping windows or deterministic repeated calls as independent evidence
impose the source-project recommended repetition count
